title: West Alabama Family Finds Mysterious "Haunted" Box On Property
excerpt: An Alabama family on Hulu's Repossessed kept seeing a young girl in a long black dress who wasn't theirs. Then their 40-pound chandelier started spinning on its own at four in the morning.
content:
This is that spooky time of the year. Halloween is right around the corner. Yeah, but so is a couple of shadow people. Some folks love scary/supernatural stuff, while others really have no stomach for spirits and things going bump in the night. Next up: something we can probably all agree on.

It usually ends up on the "things you do not want to discover" list for everyone.

Get our free mobile app

Nobody wants to discover their house is haunted. That's why I prefer newer homes with very little history. It actually happened to me back in 1998. My family moved into a beautiful home in Missouri. Our home sat on a busy intersection, and minor car accidents happened frequently. One night, as I looked out our kitchen window, I witnessed a three-car pileup.

The police arrived and talked with all witnesses, including me. However, at the end of our chat, the police officer looked at me and said, "Man, I have not been back here since that awful, awful night 15 years ago." I'm perplexed, and he can see that written all over my face. That's when the officer revealed to me that 15 years ago, a family was murdered (by their own husband/father) in the upstairs bedrooms. The officer told me it was absolutely the worst crime scene he had ever seen, before or after.

YEAH, THAT WAS HOW I DISCOVERED THAT MY HOUSE WAS HAUNTED!

I know laws vary by state on what owners must reveal to buyers when a home is sold or purchased. Next, we find a West Alabama family who simply stumbled upon a box with a sordid history. Let's get into the history as well as the Hulu show they

"Repossessed" is a paranormal investigation show on Hulu.

One investigation focuses on a family in Tuscaloosa County with a very spooky story. The show deals with the Tuscaloosa-related investigation in season 1, episode 2.

It started with sounds here and there and seeing things that weren't really there.

The property owner's wife saw a little girl in the house who wasn't their daughter and looked to be around 10 years old.

It got more serious after those sightings.

The homeowner spoke with me this morning and told me this:

Every member of our family (wife, son, daughter, and mother-in-law) had seen a small, maybe 4-foot shadowy figure. Only my wife has seen it vividly enough to make it out. She said it is a girl child. Long black hair in a long dress.

One night, I was in bed, just about to doze off when she came in the room and shouted to my daughter (who was 12 at the time) “Emilee, time to go to bed.”

I looked around and told her she was in bed. At that point she pulled the bedroom door back and said she had seen her run behind the door and thought she was trying to jump out and scare her. Nobody was there.

We have all been awaken by unrecognizable voices at night. My mother-in-law, who lives with us, has heard them in the day as well.

One morning, around 4AM, I was sitting in my living room reading my devotional. I kept hearing what I thought was the dining room chairs being moved. After four attempts of getting up to see what it was, I set my phone on the bar pointing into the dining room and started recording. After several minutes, it picked up nothing. I watched most of the video and didn’t think I had caught anything so I didn’t watch the remainder. After a couple of days, curiosity got the best of me and I watched the rest. That’s when I found movement. The chandelier, which is antique and very heavy, turns. It’s hard to turn even trying. It’s not made to swivel at all. Then it starts swinging. Again, it weighs maybe 40 pounds. It comes to an immediate stop and then a vase on the table moves almost a foot. 

Now, watch the video of the chandelier and vase incident yourself.

Credit: ikedaniel7 via TikTok

Again, no one in the family was present when the chandelier and vase moved on their own.

This family then contacted Fox Paranormal in Georgia to come investigate the home.

That is when they discovered this "voodoo" box buried in the backyard.

Just look at this box and how unbelievably creepy it is.
